notes.title: Extra XP from Customer Reviews and Online Orders
notes.content:
1- Extra XP from Customer Reviews
100% increase!

As you know, you get extra level points if you complete a day with more than 4 points.

Here are the updated numbers:

If your review score is 4.00, you get 20 level points instead of 10 level points.

If you're above 4.00, you get more level points (20+). The higher the review score, the higher the level points.

If your review score is 5.00, you get 50 level points instead of 25 level points.

You can see how many level points you earn in the daily report.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/86265b9b86a686e54cf7c96a216c9e11dd1838ed.jpg"]

As a reminder:

You can check your current score from the Desktop-Customer Reviews.

How to increase customer satisfaction?

* Avoid long checkout queues
* Keep the store clean
* Set product prices by considering the recommended prices
* Let your customers find all products in the store racks
* Place some decorations to provide a beautiful atmosphere
* Place some speakers and let your customers listen to some relaxing music in your store

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/7d82475d6e6b5ee36499dd90567e21eb2281821d.jpg"]
2- Extra XP from Online Orders
Each completed online order brings 20 level points instead of 15.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/b140d2f66cd148f8995b12558ef6ed404ce879a1.jpg"]


3- Business Tycoon is removed from the shopping bags
Now there is nothing written on the shopping bags, but your store logo is still there.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/fb068b71ddc558a0c00c9e8a3097a3c59ffe7cf6.jpg"]



Sporting Goods Shop is now available in Early Access!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3653250/Sporting_Goods_Shop/"][/dynamiclink]

New Shortcut - Add to Cart
You can add any product to your shopping cart using the T-key (by default).
There are 5 ways to use this shortcut:

notes.title: v[0.1.023] New Shortcut - Check Inventory
notes.content:
1- New Shortcut - Check Inventory

You can hold the Z-key (by default) to check your inventory.
When you hold the Z-key (by default), you can see how many products are in your store and how many products are in your stock.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/ee5b1c661be07dae9ec485e6e2fea386fc593c28.jpg
As you can see in the screenshot:
* There are 24 products on the store racks.
* This product's tagged store racks are for a capacity of 30 products
* There are 45 products in your stock.

It's Z-key by default. You can change it from the Options-Controls.
Keybinding:  Options -> Controls -> Check Inventory

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/96464522e432adcaca36a0ae052117e3fadacaac.jpg

There are 5 ways to use this shortcut:
1- You can check your inventory when you hover on a store rack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/770e02d41d7359ddef13ef9eda9486a44397ac03.jpg

2- You can check your inventory when you hover on an empty store rack (but tagged with a product).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/8be845639ed7bccd46ee8230cc508b9e17e4717e.jpg

3- You can check your inventory when you hover on a warehouse rack spot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/ebfadfe3077f4a01ef70ede69f8fe128bf44557d.jpg

4- You can check your inventory when you hover on an empty warehouse rack spot (but tagged with a product).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/3787d348a354c8c65d89e50019c6addb28eeba89.jpg

5- You can check your inventory when you hover on a box on the ground.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/9f4dfe119e3abfce23ef5c466ee8a718215aa074.jpg

2- New Warning: No product in a market category
There is a new warning for someone having trouble with signing the first contract.

If there is no product in a market category, it means that you haven't signed any contract in that category yet.
If there is no product in the market section at all, it means that you haven't signed any contract yet.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/b55a7caa353b6211b13c20f15c710209ab4c25f5.jpg

notes.title: v[0.1.014] New Rack and Product Category
notes.content:
1- New Rack: Pipe Wall Rack
There is a new wall rack for pipes (with a capacity of 60).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/dd9ca10bb5c6655ac7051f13113dd346ca57bfc4.png

You can buy this "Pipe Wall Rack" in the Market-Equipment section.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/7de03a5ddb8e1f771998b0d36a6fdc8aeef1053e.jpg

This is how it looks like in the store.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/a230e808aab2762dc4898cdc7d2caff30e1691e4.jpg

2- Market: Online Orders
If you go to the Desktop-Market section, you'll see a new category named "Online Orders".
It will be easier to order all required products to complete the online orders.
You'll also see how many of these products are in your store and stock.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/497affcf3221c42e4aab5e2d013a4c39bbda263d.jpg

* Fixed the self-checkout stuck issue during day-end
* Fixed some translation mistakes

notes.title: v[0.1.011] Security Guard
notes.content:
Security Guard

Finally, your security guard is here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/ca8d293e41922c5750e778a9ff5503c54a757202.jpg

When a thief is around, he will chase the thief, and you'll get a notification on the top-left corner of the screen: "Security Guard is chasing a thief right now".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/3f74e6f0eea5833a6e6d08de2bdc761ffbc5672d.jpg

Please remember that sometimes two thieves visit you at the same time. When your security guard is chasing a thief, it's better to check around (if there is any other thief).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/0c0726bbcf86329fedc0a007b68c3b0fd9136e4e.jpg

As you know, you earn level points when you hit the thieves.
(The higher the store level, the higher the level points from hitting the thieves)
You'll earn level points when your security guard hits the thieves, too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/6e43fe0c57447387f6efffcac4dfbe30173d553a.png

You can hire a security guard from the Desktop-Worker section.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/bdedd5d85b6e4fc07880d79da01b0e8856167061.jpg

notes.title: v[0.1.008] Pause the Stockers
notes.content:
1- Pause the Stockers
You can send your stockers to a break. Meanwhile, you can design your store and warehouse.
When you finish your design, you can make your stockers start working.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/175ac20f38a856466de6f0106556ddbef6c1558f.jpg

Please go to the Desktop-Workers section. There is a new button (that appears when there is a minimum of one stocker hired).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/bf21030e96f746ce0c61abb45b0be5c95adb0c8b.jpg

Press the button to send your stockers to a break.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/401b7e74bf08c6f90dd44486c7aa0f62d95e993d.jpg

Press the button again to end their break and make them work.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/d09cba3af200090dbb09386de6ba77ad5d9b0890.jpg

2- Online Order - Market and Inventory Buttons
Two new buttons have been added to the Desktop-Online Order.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/862fb5af0475cc1ac4de1e055d9bc7f34233cfa7.jpg

* Fixed the brand name and logo issues

notes.title: v[0.1.005] New Products, New Wall Rack, Set Price Filter, Hit Thieves to Earn XP
notes.content:
1- New Products
8 new products added
Cigarettes, ashtrays, cones, e-cigarettes, filter tubes, and volume tobacco

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/5084535e83a152bd6f6e9a8bf701ce5afbbaf273.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/5833393d81b5850c042947af9dba088041d0518d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/3cea1487640269f1e453cef173e2378e70320785.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/31eb35aabfc82f3cd8acd8ff1a986da0784e048c.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/57deb96ec43cff16e99bf1b9ddcfa64d97ccf103.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/9c70fe092d759c21bb8e73c0a9f6d109205be23e.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/13c06aaca35204bd7e756edd510ae443a0800844.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/d69fd2c525a063127df49b0f23205148963d6897.png

2- New Wall Rack (Only small products)
As it's highly requested, there is a new wall rack for small products (with a capacity of 160).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/6d746fd24ed0e6cbd4e85fc299fe42d4a93f1305.png

You can buy this "Wall Rack" in the Market-Equipment section.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/6e3b4b741084c654af026ff7275eac0fb168fee9.jpg

This is how it looks like in the store.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/dd4bbcb42405514dcc6ea5ebb20e412c737c09e3.jpg

3- Set Price - Filter Button 
There is a filter button on Set Price.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/1a221539d642a9c1aabd6abd67779fddcfbec543.jpg

Filters are All, Price Changed Products, Lower Than Recommended, Higher Than Recommended.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/4b18c3b8d160a6f40f665bc97ba71bb89da93ee8.jpg

Price Changed Products filter will help you easily check the daily changes at the day start.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/94772f9bcdbca8136df4b9f66b5e4546fbbe82ce.jpg

4- Hit the Thieves to Earn Level Points
You can earn level points when you hit the thieves.
(The higher the store level, the higher the level points from hitting the thieves)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45196742/7136e461ec64292f20f5956e1e580287d5f79af0.jpg

* When you fill a store rack (fully), stockers won't go for filling that store rack (Unless they've already started their journey)
